propositions: CI has no lock against main for complexity-baseline.json, unlike module-size-limit.txt, allowing contributor changes to land without administrator review
The baseline can grow by adding new entries because the test guards entry count matching and stale list emptiness but not monotonic non-increasing entry count
The module-size limit lock fails open when git fetch of main flakes, running the cap against an unverified value from the current branch instead of failing closed
A semantic shrink-only lock must allow entry removal and ceiling lowering while rejecting ceiling raises and new entries
Adding a high-complexity function with a matching baseline entry in the same change currently passes because the entry count and stale checks cannot distinguish new entries from existing ones
